findings.title: axe target-size: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
findings.description: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space (serious impact). Fix any of the following: Target has insufficient size (20px by 20px, should be at least 24px by 24px) Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 20px instead of at least 24px.

<button class="icon-btn" type="button" id="toggle-password" aria-label="Show password">

findings.recommendation: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
